# RepLedger — Agent Reputation Ledger

> Every agent earns its record.

## What is RepLedger?

RepLedger is an AI agent reputation tracking system. It lets you register AI agents, log their outcomes, and generate evidence-backed reputation scores and tier badges. Part of the [AgenticTrust](https://agentictrust.app) suite.

## Core Features

- **Agent Registration**: Register AI agents and track their identity across systems
- **Outcome Logging**: Record task outcomes (success/failure) with cryptographic verification
- **Reputation Scoring**: Evidence-backed trust scores based on actual performance data
- **Tier Badges**: SVG badges (Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum) that agents can embed anywhere
- **Public Profiles**: Shareable agent reputation pages with verified outcome history
- **API Access**: Full REST API for programmatic agent registration and scoring

## For Developers

- REST API with API key authentication
- Tier badge embeddable via URL
- Public agent profile pages
- Webhook support for outcome notifications

## Architecture

- Frontend: React 19 with Swiss High-Contrast design system
- Backend: Python/FastAPI
- Database: MongoDB
- Hosted on Railway
